title: Operator card: two rows, focus is a bar
why: Critic on 62 and 63 (3 and 2 of 5): the Back row repeated the X and Esc (three ways to close), and the focused row was a full width accent slab. Back goes, and focus is the shared row look: a raised fill and a 3px accent bar.
now: The operator card has New party and Exit demo, and the X closes it.

edits.anchor: function arcadeOpRows(){ return [{id:'party',label:(ARCOP&&ARCOP.arm)?'Confirm new party':'New party'},{id:'exit',label:'Exit demo'},{id:'back',label:'Back'}]; }
